He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking

programme.desc: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Too

programme.desc: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.
programme.title: Look Who's Talking Now

programme.desc: Matilda is a gifted child, more gifted than any other, but her parents won't let her go to school. She teaches herself for years by going to the library and reading everything she sees. Eventually she convinces her parents to let her go to school, but discovers her special talents are needed to protect the school and her lovely teacher from the evil headmistress.
programme.title: Matilda

programme.desc: Nov 2026 Previews of the great films now playing on Sky Cinema, plus other highlights showing on Sky.
programme.title: Sky Cinema Preview

programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
programme.title: The Borrowers

programme.desc: Perennial family favourite about Dorothy, a young girl from the American Midwest, who is swept by a cyclone to a magical kingdom over the rainbow. There she meets a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion, who join her on a quest to find the all-powerful Wizard of Oz, the only man who can help her get back to Kansas. However, the Wicked Witch of the West has other plans for Dorothy and her new friends.
programme.title: The Wizard of Oz

programme.desc: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.
programme.title: Babe

programme.desc: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in an adventure.
programme.title: Casper

programme.desc: A toy company develops action-figure soldiers whose realistic fighting capabilities cause mayhem for a toy-shop owner and his family. Unaware of their military prowess, the shopkeeper takes delivery of the soldiers, who break free from their packaging to attack their Gorgonite enemies. When the Gorgonites communicate with the shopkeeper's son, the humans find themselves under siege.
programme.title: Small Soldiers

programme.desc: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.
programme.title: The Borrowers

programme.desc: A ten-year-old boy befriends and shelters a gentle alien creature who has been stranded on Earth. When the authorities are alerted to this unusual house guest, the boy tries to help the creature return home before menacing government agents close in. The film won three Academy Awards for music, sound and special effects.
programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

programme.desc: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.
programme.title: Liar Liar

programme.desc: A lonely boy-ghost befriends the young daughter of a ghost hunter. A grasping heiress calls in the exorcist to clear out the spooks and gain access to the treasures supposedly hidden in the lonely mansion. Father and daughter discover that Casper is not the only spirit haunting the house and find themselves caught up in an adventure.
programme.title: Casper

programme.desc: The lives of Gomez and Morticia Addams are thrown into disarray when a scheming siren attempts to pass off her son as Gomez's long-lost brother Fester. Once installed in the family's spooky mansion, mother and son set their minds on stealing the family fortune.
programme.title: The Addams Family

programme.desc: With Wednesday and Pugsley off to summer camp, a greedy nanny plots to marry and murder wealthy Uncle Fester.
programme.title: Addams Family Values

programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.
programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.desc: A tough cop is forced to go undercover as a kindergarten teacher. In his new role, he must track down a mother and son who are the only witnesses against a drug-dealing criminal, who is also their husband and father. The cop uses his brutal methods to negotiate the mundane problems of child control.
programme.title: Kindergarten Cop

programme.desc: An overstressed husband becomes obsessed with finding out the secret of his mysterious new neighbours. Concocting a series of increasingly outlandish schemes to discover the truth about the weird sounds he hears coming from the basement next door, the man settles on the theory that the family are a front for a cannibalistic cult.
programme.title: The 'Burbs

programme.desc: Bart, a black railroad worker is appointed sheriff of a town marked for destruction by Hedley Lamarr, a scheming politician. As Lamarr tries to drive out the town's residents, Bart decides to stand in his way.
programme.title: Blazing Saddles

programme.desc: Lighthearted adventures of a pair of news vendors in New York - one deaf, one blind - who go on the run when they are blamed for the murder of a customer. Each has seen - or heard - just a whiff of a clue, and a frantic chase ensues as the duo struggle to clear their names.
programme.title: See No Evil, Hear No Evil

programme.desc: A teen suffers the pain of adolescence as she longs for Mr Right while fending off the advances of the class clown.
programme.title: Sixteen Candles

programme.desc: An out-of-work actor dresses in drag for an audition, only to land the female lead in a TV soap. When he becomes the most popular character on the show, he feels compelled to carry the persona into his everyday life. While bringing him phenomenal success as an `actress', life as a woman also has its problems - especially when he falls for an actress with whom he works.
programme.title: Tootsie

programme.desc: When one-time rock hopeful Robbie is jilted at the altar, he vents his bitterness in song, even when singing at other people's weddings. Only true love can redeem the broken-hearted songster but fortunately, he's about to meet a woman who will spin him right round (like a record).
programme.title: The Wedding Singer

programme.desc: An unconventional sleuth attempts to find a football team's stolen mascot dolphin. The Miami Dolphins are aghast when their beloved Snowflake is abducted one week before the all-important Super Bowl, so they call in Ace Ventura, a private eye who uses unorthodox methods to retrieve missing animals.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective

programme.desc: Legendary pet detective Ace Ventura returns for another adventure when he's coerced out of retirement while on a soul-searching retreat in the Himalayas. He must now retrieve an endangered white bat from a village located in Africa. The sacred animal was offered up as a wedding dowry from the Wachootoo prince to the Wachati princess, and, if Ace can't track down the culprit behind the kidnapping in time, civil war will break out between the two rival tribes.
programme.title: Ace Ventura: When Nature Calls

programme.desc: A thirtysomething slacker attempts to inject some stability into his life by adopting an impressionable five-year-old.
programme.title: Big Daddy

programme.desc: Fastidious businessman Neal Page and slobbish shower-curtain salesman Del Griffith are the reluctant odd couple trying to get home from New York to Chicago to be with their families at Thanksgiving. Their thwarted travel plans keep throwing them together.
programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles

programme.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial

programme.desc: Grown-up Peter Pan has to return to Neverland to rediscover his true identity in order to rescue his children from the clutches of the evil Captain Hook. Peter has grown up into a workaholic executive but takes time off for a holiday in London. Once there, his children are kidnapped by Hook, and Peter must throw off his corporate image and go back to Neverland to save his children.
programme.title: Hook

programme.desc: Epic tale in which an intrepid archaeologist tries to beat a band of Nazis to a unique religious relic which is central to their plans for world domination. Battling against a snake phobia and a vengeful ex-girlfriend, Indiana Jones is in constant peril, making hair's-breadth escapes at every turn in this celebration of the innocent adventure movies of an earlier era.
programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark

programme.desc: Adventure sequel. Intrepid archaeologist Indiana Jones, on the trail of fortune and glory in Old Shanghai, is ricocheted into a dangerous adventure in India. With his faithful companion Short Round and nightclub singer Willie Scott, Indie goes in search of the magical Sankara stone, and uncovers an ancient evil which threatens all who come into contact with it.
programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom

programme.desc: The intrepid explorer Indiana Jones sets out to rescue his father, a medievalist who has vanished while searching for the Holy Grail. Following clues in the old man's notebook, Indy arrives in Venice, where he enlists the help of a beautiful academic, but they are not the only ones who are on the trail, and some sinister old enemies soon come out of the woodwork.
programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade

programme.desc: On his return from the Crusades, Robin of Locksley learns that his father has been murdered by the tyrannical Sheriff of Nottingham and embarks on a campaign of guerrilla warfare to protect King Richard's throne. Fight scenes are lively and inventive, and a set piece fought under the forest canopy pulls out all the stops.
programme.title: Robin Hood: Prince of Thieves

programme.desc: Vietnam veteran John J Rambo is pushed too far by the sheriff of a small American town. After being wrongfully arrested, he escapes and leads lawmen and an army detachment on a chase through the mountains.
programme.title: First Blood

programme.desc: War veteran John Rambo takes on the entire Vietnamese army, plus Soviet advisers, when he is released from prison and sent back to present-day Vietnam in search of American prisoners of war still being held in enemy custody.
programme.title: Rambo: First Blood Part II

programme.desc: Reluctant one-man army Rambo goes into action against brutal Soviet invaders in Afghanistan. Sought out in a Buddhist monastery retreat, Rambo declines his former commander's request for help to deliver missiles to the mujahideen, but when his superior is captured and imprisoned, the hulking hero brings out the big guns.
programme.title: Rambo III

programme.desc: A CIA agent comes up against a duplicitous American government during his quest to nab a Colombian drug lord.
programme.title: Clear and Present Danger

programme.desc: Sinbad sails to the island of Colossa to rescue a beautiful princess from an evil sorcerer's spell. Once there, he does battle with a succession of marvellous creatures.
programme.title: The 7th Voyage of Sinbad

programme.desc: Batman battles super-villain Mr Freeze and seductive eco-terrorist Poison Ivy. With Freeze planning a permanent winter, faithful butler Alfred falling to a mysterious illness, and Ivy coming between the caped crusader and Robin, teaming up with Batgirl is the crime-fighting duo's only chance of saving the day.
programme.title: Batman & Robin

programme.desc: Detective Nick Curran is charged with finding out the truth after Catherine Tramell, a sensual bisexual writer, is suspected of murdering her lover with an ice pick, exactly the method used in one of her books. Unfortunately, he becomes too closely involved.
programme.title: Basic Instinct

programme.desc: The Chipmunks believe that Dave plans to propose to his new girlfriend in Miami and dump them. They have three days to get to him and save themselves not only from losing Dave but also from gaining a terrible stepbrother.
programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Road Chip

programme.desc: Three singing chipmunks are happily residing in a lovely tree until their green home gets chopped down and taken to be the Christmas tree in the reception of an LA record company. There, they buddy up with failing songwriter Dave, who realises the talented critters have got the potential for big musical success. When the chipmunks are signed by big-shot producer Ian, will fame and fortune go to their heads?
programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks

programme.desc: The loveable rodents Alvin, Simon and Theodore must enrol in school when their human friend Dave is hospitalised. In addition to bearing the unwelcome attention of bullies, they also discover that the school's music department is threatened by financial cuts. Their attempts to save it are hampered by a group of female chipmunks, the Chipettes, who are managed by the Chipmunks' sworn enemy, Ian.
programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: The Squeakquel

programme.desc: On a cruise, the Chipmunks and the Chipettes go overboard and are washed up on an island. They hope they will be rescued soon.
programme.title: Alvin and the Chipmunks: Chipwrecked

programme.desc: Discover some of the very best Sky Originals to watch with the whole family, from 'Monster Family' to 'The Amazing Maurice'.
programme.title: The Cinema List: Family Favourites

programme.desc: Bitten by a radioactive spider, teenager Miles Morales suddenly develops mysterious powers that transform him into Spider-Man. He must now use his newfound skills to battle the evil Kingpin, a hulking madman who can open portals to other universes.
programme.title: Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse

programme.desc: A shy student becomes a crime fighter after a bite from a mutant spider, during a school outing, gives him extraordinary powers. As he comes to terms with his new-found abilities, he is also forced to contend with a maniac villain known as the Green Goblin.
programme.title: Spider-Man

programme.desc: When a failed nuclear fusion experiment results in an explosion that kills his wife, Dr. Otto Octavius is transformed into Dr. Octopus, a cyborg with deadly metal tentacles. Doc Ock blames Spider-Man for the accident and seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Spidey's alter ego, Peter Parker, faces fading powers and self-doubt. Complicating matters are his best friend's hatred for Spider-Man and his true love's sudden engagement to another man.
programme.title: Spider-Man 2

The trio's successful efforts to finance these covert operations contributes to the fall of the Soviet Union and the end of the Cold War.

Julia and Tom start an affair, but soon she realizes that Tom is just using her to advance his own career and that of his other girlfriend, actress Avice Crichton (Lucy Punch). Meanwhile, the women (Olivia Wilde, Alexandra Maria Lara) in their lives can only watch as both drivers risk death with every lap.

Amy starts to wonder if it's time to clean up her act.

But baby-sitting overnight unexpectedly turns into a week, and Kate's life spins into chaos. programme.title: Friends - The One Where Chandler Doesn't Like Dogs

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Rumor
programme.desc: Monica encounters a high-school friend (guest star Brad Pitt) and invites him to Thanksgiving Day dinner.

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Dirty Girl

programme.title: Friends - The One With Chandler in a Box

programme.title: Friends - The One Where They're Going to Party!

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Bitcoin Entanglement
programme.desc: Sheldon tries to teach the guys a lesson after they cut him out of a potentially valuable investment; a seven-year-old video reveals a secret about Leonard and Penny's relationship.

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Confidence Erosion

programme.title: The Big Bang Theory - The Celebration Reverberation

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Girl From Poughkeepsie

programme.title: Friends - The One With Phoebe's Uterus

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Embryos
programme.desc: Phoebe undergoes an embryo implant procedure to become a surrogate mother for her brother and his wife; Monica and Rachel wager their apartment in a trivia game against Chandler and Joey.

programme.title: Friends - The One With Rachel's Crush
programme.desc: Chandler has a hard time handling Kathy's new role in a play, in which she pretends to have sex with a handsome man.

programme.title: Friends - The One With All the Rugby
programme.desc: Chandler runs into Janice, now divorced, and finds her more irritating than ever; Ross plays rugby to impress Emily; Monica tries to figure out what a mysterious electrical switch in her new apartment does.

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Fake Party
programme.desc: Rachel throws Emily a phony going-away party so she can see Joshua outside of work, and pregnant Phoebe craves meat.

programme.title: Friends - The One With the Free Porn
programme.desc: Ross tells Emily (Helen Baxendale) how he feels about her; Chandler and Joey suddenly receive a free adult TV channel in their apartment; Phoebe gets some surprising news about her pregnancy.

programme.title: The Neighborhood - Welcome to the Remodel

programme.title: The Neighborhood - Welcome to the Dream Girls

programme.title: SpongeBob SquarePants - Growth Spout; Stuck in the Wringer

programme.desc: Tracker and Lucita Buena call on the Air Rescue Pups to help save an irreplaceable Mother Tree; it's then up to the Paw Patrol to fix Mr. Porter's ice cream freezer before everything melts!

He is summoned from his life as an unwanted child to become a student at Hogwarts, an English boarding school for wizards. There, he meets several friends who become his closest allies and help him discover the truth about his parents' mysterious deaths.

programme.desc: S02 E01 Model Kid; Public Television of the Dead Joe's closest friends are the model toys of his favorite scary movie monsters; a public TV station is overwhelmed when the appraisal of an antique book summons a dark force.

programme.title: Creepshow
programme.desc: S02 E02 Dead & Breakfast, Pesticide A marketing ploy at a haunted Bed and Breakfast becomes too realistic; an exterminator gets more than he bargained for when he takes on a big job.

programme.title: Creepshow
programme.desc: S02 E03 The Right Snuff; Sibling Rivalry A misunderstanding in space ensures two astronauts go down in history for all the worst reasons; Lola is convinced her brother is trying to kill her, but she's worried about the wrong monster.

programme.title: Compromising Positions
programme.desc: The murder of a swinging Long Island dentist puts an ex-reporter housewife (Susan Sarandon) onto a story.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: An inept magician (Alan Arkin) and a ragged scullery woman (Tammy Grimes) join a unicorn's (Mia Farrow) quest to free her kind from an evil king's ocean prison.

programme.title: My Best Fiend
programme.desc: Filmmaker Werner Herzog narrates an exploration of his love-hate relationship with actor Klaus Kinski.

programme.title: Trial by Jury
programme.desc: A New York mob boss (Armand Assante) tries to ensure his acquittal by scaring a single mother (Joanne Whalley-Kilmer) on the jury.

programme.title: The Warrior's Way
programme.desc: Refusing to kill an infant from an enemy clan, a master swordsman (Jang Dong-gun) takes the child and flees to an American frontier town.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Guns
programme.desc: In the lawless West, a notorious brotherhood of killers and thieves called The Cowboys reigns over the land with brutal fists and fast guns. Fate finally catches up with them.

programme.title: Valentine: The Dark Avenger
programme.desc: A chance meeting with a film director leads to a waitress turned actress's transformation into a consummate superhero.

programme.title: Tragedy Girls
programme.desc: Teenage crime reporters Sadie and McKayla are hot on the trail of a crazed serial killer. After capturing the maniac and holding him hostage, they soon realize that the best way to boost their social media stardom is to commit the murders themselves.

programme.title: Unlawful Entry
programme.desc: A creepy policeman (Ray Liotta) gets close to a Los Angeles couple (Kurt Russell, Madeleine Stowe) in order to drive them apart.

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos.

programme.title: Ballistic
programme.desc: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge.

programme.title: Not Without Hope
programme.desc: Four friends face disaster when their boat capsizes in the Gulf of Mexico. Battling massive waves, sharks, dehydration and hypothermia, they cling to hope as Capt. Timothy Close and his Coast Guard crew launch a daring rescue through a raging storm to save them.

programme.title: The Back-up Plan
programme.desc: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture.

programme.title: No Strings Attached
programme.desc: Lifelong friends Emma (Natalie Portman) and Adam (Ashton Kutcher) take their relationship to the next level by having sex. Afraid of ruining their friendship, the new lovers make a pact to keep things purely physical, with no fighting, no jealousy and no expectations. Emma and Adam pledge to do whatever they want, wherever they want, as long as they do not fall in love. The question then becomes: Who will fall first?

programme.title: It Gets Worse - Stop All The Cocks
programme.desc: Ethan, Abi and Sam attend a funeral for an old friend from university; the funeral brings their love and loneliness to the surface; Abi reflects on her relationship with Tom; Ethan pursues Aaron; and Sam wrestles with her guilt.

programme.title: It Gets Worse - People Team
programme.desc: Ethan, Abi and Sam attempt to reconcile, but the new chapter only reveals that their messy lives are far from resolved; surely it gets better than this, right? But who needs better, when they have each other?

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Hard Rain
programme.desc: The small town of Huntingburg is forced to evacuate when torrential rains bring rising floodwaters. The local sheriff and town residents, having been through this before, are all too familiar with the looting and petty thefts that take place in an abandoned town. What they are not aware of, however, is the planned heist of an armored car sent to transport the $3 million from local banks.

programme.title: Persona
programme.desc: Two injured women find themselves trapped inside a secluded home with no memory of how they got there. Scared, confused, and distrustful of each other, they must figure out a way to escape before their captor comes back for them.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crue of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

programme.title: True Grit
programme.desc: After an outlaw named Tom Chaney murders her father, feisty 14-year-old farm girl Mattie Ross hires Rooster Cogburn, a boozy, trigger-happy lawman, to help her find Chaney and avenge her father. The bickering duo are not alone in their quest, for a Texas Ranger named LaBoeuf is also tracking Chaney for reasons of his own. Together the unlikely trio ventures into hostile territory to dispense some Old West justice.

programme.title: American Assassin
programme.desc: When Cold War veteran Stan Hurley takes CIA black ops recruit Mitch Rapp under his wing, they receive an assignment to investigate a wave of random attacks on both military and civilian targets. After discovering a pattern of violence, Hurley and Rapp join forces with a lethal Turkish agent to stop a mysterious operative who wants to start a global war.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: After his wife (Liv Tyler) leaves him, a fry cook (Rainn Wilson) emulates a TV superhero and transforms himself into a costumed vigilante.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: War Pony
programme.desc: The interlocking stories of two young Oglala Lakota men grappling with a world built against them as they navigate their unique paths to manhood.

programme.title: Chocolat
programme.desc: When mysterious Vianne and her child arrive in a tranquil French town in the winter of 1959, no one could have imagined the impact that she and her spirited daughter would have on the community stubbornly rooted in tradition. Within days, she opens an unusual chocolate shop, across the square from the church. Her ability to perceive her customers' desires and satisfy them with just the right confection, coaxes the villagers to abandon themselves to temptation -- just as Lent begins.

programme.title: The Kid
programme.desc: A young boxer who hopes to become a champion keeps his activities a secret from his disapproving parents.

programme.title: Brave the Dark
programme.desc: When Mr. Deen discovers one of his students has been living out of his car and thrown into jail, he decides to bail him out. Determined to curb Nate's self-destructive behavior, Mr. Deen discovers a host of secrets that are slowly tearing Nate apart.

programme.title: Marvelous and the Black Hole
programme.desc: A rebellious 13-year-old who is dealing with the loss of her mother embarks on an adventure with a children's party magician.

programme.title: Queen of the Desert
programme.desc: Gertrude Bell's life as an explorer, cartographer, and archaeologist for the British Empire.

programme.title: Lilies Not for Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Don Jon
programme.desc: New Jersey bartender Jon Martello knows what's important: his friends, his family, his car, his church, his sexual conquests -- and porn. In fact, Jon is a porn addict and has never had a genuine relationship with a woman. However, when he meets Barbara he has to change his operating methods, because Barbara won't be bedded easily. For the first time in his life, Jon begins a real courtship, but his obsession with erotica threatens to ruin everything.

programme.title: All the World Is Sleeping
programme.desc: A young mother in New Mexico sinks deeper into addiction while struggling to care for her daughter.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: The Weather Man
programme.desc: David Spritz (Nicolas Cage) is a Chicago weatherman who, despite success at his job, is deeply unhappy. Eclipsed by his father, Robert (Michael Caine), a celebrated author, and licking his wounds after his marriage to Noreen (Hope Davis) collapses, David resolves to get his life in order by applying for a high-profile job on a New York City talk show. But with his personal life a shambles, David must decide between fast-tracking his career and repairing his rapidly deteriorating family life.

programme.title: The Death of Stalin
programme.desc: When tyrannical dictator Joseph Stalin dies in 1953, his parasitic cronies square off in a frantic power struggle to become the next Soviet leader. Among the contenders are the dweebish Georgy Malenkov, the wily Nikita Khrushchev and Lavrentiy Beria -- the sadistic secret police chief. As they bumble, brawl and back-stab their way to the top, the question remains -- just who is running the government?

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: Despite being well into adulthood, brothers Doug and Steve Butabi still live at home and work in the flower shop owned by their dad. They exist only to hit on women at discos, though they're routinely unsuccessful until a chance run-in with Richard Grieco gets them inside the swank Roxbury club. Mistaken for high rollers, they meet their dream women, Vivica and Cambi, and resolve to open a club of their own.

programme.title: Office Christmas Party
programme.desc: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs.

programme.title: Jackass: The Movie
programme.desc: In this comedic documentary, Johnny Knoxville heads a crew of stuntmen, skateboarders and all-around lunatics as they prank, embarrass and torture each other in the name of fun. The antics range from childlike -- the boys don panda suits for a romp through Tokyo -- to grotesque and life-threatening. A golf cart demolition derby turns downright dangerous. Live gators nearly chomp maniac Steve-O. Filmmaker Spike Jonze and Knoxville, in heavy makeup, test the public's patience for the elderly.

programme.title: Jackass: Number Two
programme.desc: Daredevils (Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O) go for the gross-out when they subject an unsuspecting public to more outrageous stunts and practical jokes. Danger, pain and bodily fluids are in plentiful supply as the gang tries to up the ante in the continuous quest to shock and annoy.

programme.title: Along Came a Spider
programme.desc: A psychological suspense thriller adapted from James Patterson's first highly acclaimed novel in the Alex Cross series, Morgan Freeman reprises his role as the Washington, D.C. police detective and psychologist who is through playing mind games with criminals -- that is until a methodical predator, Gary Soneji (Michael Wincott) commits a daring kidnapping and lures Cross into the case.

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery.

programme.title: A Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect.

programme.title: Nine
programme.desc: Italian film director Guido Contini (Daniel Day-Lewis) grapples with epic crises in his personal and professional lives. At the same time, he must strike a balance of the demands of numerous women in his life, including his wife (Marion Cotillard), his mistress (Penélope Cruz), and his confidant (Judi Dench).

programme.title: Dreamgirls
programme.desc: Deena (Beyoncé Knowles), Effie (Jennifer Hudson) and Lorrell (Anika Noni Rose) form a music trio called the Dreamettes. When ambitious manager Curtis Taylor Jr. (Jamie Foxx) spots the act at a talent show, he offers the chance of a lifetime, to be backup singers for a national star (Eddie Murphy). Taylor takes creative control of the group and eventually pushes the singers into the spotlight. However, one becomes the star, forcing another out, which teaches them about the high cost of fame.

programme.title: Selena
programme.desc: In this biographical drama, Selena Quintanilla (Jennifer Lopez) is born into a musical Mexican-American family in Texas. Her father, Abraham (Edward James Olmos), realizes that his young daughter is talented and begins performing with her at small venues. She finds success and falls for her guitarist, Chris Perez (Jon Seda), who draws the ire of her father. Seeking mainstream stardom, Selena begins recording an English-language album which, tragically, she would never complete.

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat.

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

programme.title: Spotlights: A Showtime Short Film Series
programme.desc: A collection of short films showcasing different themes.

programme.title: She's All That
programme.desc: High school hotshot Zach Siler (Freddie Prinze Jr.) is the envy of his peers. But his popularity declines sharply when his cheerleader girlfriend, Taylor (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), leaves him for sleazy reality-television star Brock Hudson (Matthew Lillard). Desperate to revive his fading reputation, Siler agrees to a seemingly impossible challenge. He has six weeks to gain the trust of nerdy outcast Laney Boggs (Rachael Leigh Cook) -- and help her to become the school's next prom queen.

programme.title: Fightland - Protect Yourself at All Times
programme.desc: London's gangland is pushed to the brink of war; but for Duke, the consequences strike painfully close to home.

programme.title: Fightland - I Want This
programme.desc: A deadly rescue mission opens up new possibilities for Duke, until an almighty twist causes his overwhelming need for revenge to eclipse him once more.

programme.title: Fightland - There Is a War Coming
programme.desc: Duke prepares for his long-awaited shot at revenge, while others take matters into their own hands.

programme.title: Fightland - Without Me, There Is No You
programme.desc: With time running out and relationships breaking apart, Duke closes in on his target; but an unexpected countermove leaves him staring down the barrel of defeat.

programme.title: Fightland - You Won't See Me Coming
programme.desc: An explosive showdown leads Duke to a surprising truth, rocking him to the core, as an audacious move captures the world's attention.

programme.title: Beast
programme.desc: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built.

programme.title: Splash City
programme.desc: While Slim sees basketball as a way out, his brother Juju falls deeper into street crime. Together they must choose between a brighter future and a violent legacy.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: After losing his mother to murder as a boy, Marcus (Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson) has little support in his life. He starts working for drug dealer Levar (Bill Duke) and his assistant (Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje). Although Marcus makes good money selling, his dream is to become a rapper. When he reunites with an old love (Joy Bryant) and is later shot numerous times during a robbery, Marcus decides it's time to change his life. However, his old associates won't let him go so easily.

programme.title: Oscar Shaw
programme.desc: Haunted by the tragic loss of his closest friend, a retired detective embarks on a perilous quest for vengeance as he fights to restore justice to the streets he once protected.

programme.title: The Perfect Holiday
programme.desc: Nancy (Gabrielle Union), a divorced mother of three, feels especially lonely during the holidays. Sensing her sadness, Nancy's youngest daughter, Emily (Khail Bryant), has a plan to make her mom happy again. She asks Benjamin (Morris Chestnut), a department-store Santa Claus, to pay Nancy a compliment. And Benjamin, who is also a struggling songwriter, knows exactly the right words to say.

programme.title: Nas: Time Is Illmatic
programme.desc: Rapper Nas recalls his youth in his city's housing projects, his parents' influence and the recording of his 1994 debut album, "Illmatic."

programme.title: The Longest Yard
programme.desc: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe (Adam Sandler) lands in jail, where manipulative Warden Hazen (James Cromwell) recruits him to advise the institution's team. This turns into a lead role quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against a team of prison guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach Nate Scarborough (Burt Reynolds), Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt officials trying to fix the game against them.

programme.title: The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Ex-con Marcus Cowans is trying to turn over a new leaf with the support of his loving family. After learning that one of his brothers may have been involved in a horrific crime, Marcus grapples with the limits of loyalty. He and his family, increasingly weary of the justice system's failings, soon end up in the crosshairs of a seasoned but jaded detective.

programme.title: Ava's Possessions
programme.desc: After an exorcism frees her soul, a young woman (Louisa Krause) attends Spirit Possession Anonymous and meets a fellow victim (Whitney Able) who wants her demon back.

programme.title: The Talented Mr. Ripley
programme.desc: To be young and carefree amid the blue waters and idyllic landscape of sun-drenched Italy in the late 1950s; that's la dolce vita Tom Ripley (Matt Damon) craves- and Dickie Greenleaf (Jude Law) leads. When Dickie's father asks Tom to bring his errant playboy son back home to America, Dickie and his beautiful expatriate girlfriend, Marge Sherwood (Gwyneth Paltrow), never suspect the dangerous extremes to which Ripley will go to make their lifestyle his own.

programme.title: The Dangerous Lives of Altar Boys
programme.desc: Francis Doyle (Emile Hirsch) and Tim Sullivan (Kieran Culkin), and their closest friends, are fighting the stultifying repression of their parish school. Foremost among the forces of evil is the stern and disapproving nun, Sister Assumpta (Jodie Foster), who rules their lives. She seizes their artwork one day, setting the boys on an obsessed trail of revenge that ultimately changes their lives.

programme.title: Speak No Evil
programme.desc: A dream holiday turns into a living nightmare when an American couple and their daughter spend the weekend at a British family's idyllic country estate.

programme.title: The Devil You Know
programme.desc: Ex-con Marcus Cowans is trying to turn over a new leaf with the support of his loving family. After learning that one of his brothers may have been involved in a horrific crime, Marcus grapples with the limits of loyalty. programme.title: Isolation
programme.desc: A couple vacationing in the Bahamas must run for their lives when they're attacked by pirates.

programme.title: Disaster Movie
programme.desc: During a fateful night, a group of impossibly attractive 20-somethings (Matt Lanter, Vanessa Minnillo, Kim Kardashian) must dodge a series of man-made and natural disasters. Twisters, asteroids, earthquakes and singer Amy Winehouse are just some of the perils they face while trying to make their way to safety.

programme.desc: As television writer Jerry Stahl (Ben Stiller) becomes more successful, his heroin habit grows worse. Already using when he comes to Los Angeles, Stahl finds his problems intensify when he moves in with his friend Nicky (Owen Wilson), also an addict. Eventually, Stahl marries producer Sandra (Elizabeth Hurley) to help her get a green card, and she gets him jobs on top television shows. However, more and more, he is unable to separate his addiction from his working life.

programme.title: Tales From the Crypt Presents Demon Knight
programme.desc: Ex-soldier Frank Brayker (William Sadler) is the guardian of an ancient key that can unlock tremendous evil; the sinister but charming Collector (Billy Zane) is a demon who wants the key so he can initiate the apocalypse. On the run from wicked mercenaries for almost 90 years, Brayker finally stops in at a boarding house in New Mexico where -- with the help of its quirky residents -- he plans to face off against the Collector and his band of ghouls, preventing them from ever seizing the key.

programme.title: Purple Violets
programme.desc: After the commercial failure of her critically acclaimed first novel, Patti Petalson (Selma Blair) takes a job in real estate. Married to unfaithful chef Chazz (Donal Logue), Patti is startled by a chance encounter with her former boyfriend, Brian Callahan (Patrick Wilson), now a best-selling author. As the two renew their interest in each other, Patti's teacher friend, Kate (Debra Messing), also rekindles her college relationship with Michael (Edward Burns), a lawyer and mutual friend.

programme.title: Lay the Favorite
programme.desc: A former stripper's (Rebecca Hall) talent with numbers lands her a job with a professional gambler (Bruce Willis) who runs a sports book in Las Vegas.

programme.title: This Christmas
programme.desc: At holiday time, family matriarch Ma'Dere Whitfield (Loretta Devine) assembles her large brood for their first reunion in four years. However, family ties show signs of strain when various secrets come to light, especially concerning Marine Claude's (Columbus Short) true military status, Quentin's (Idris Elba) debts and teenage Baby's (Chris Brown) secret plans to become a singer.

programme.title: Tales From the Crypt Presents Demon Knight

programme.desc: Victor Bukowski cheats on girlfriend Sylvia Weld, who rebounds and gets engaged to Dave Summers. Wishing he could undo his error, Victor happens upon two otherworldly trash collectors, who send him back in time. He uses the opportunity to woo Sylvia again, while making sure that an attractive woman catches Dave's eye. But his attraction to a waitress, Louise, could ruin Victor's plan to right things with Sylvia.

The robbery, however, leads to murder, and soon Watty leaves Billy behind and goes on the run with his beloved girlfriend, Starlene (Renée Zellweger). Heading toward Mexico, the fugitive couple gets plenty of media coverage, until there are even more people on their trail. Can Watty and Starlene make it south of the border without getting caught?

As the fate of Earth hangs in the balance, the team is put to the ultimate test as they battle Ultron, a technological terror hell-bent on human extinction. Along the way, they encounter two mysterious and powerful newcomers, Pietro and Wanda Maximoff.

programme.title: Cosmopolis
programme.desc: A 28-year-old billionaire (Robert Pattinson) senses his empire collapsing around him as he takes a limo ride across Manhattan to get a haircut from his father's old barber.

programme.desc: Colum experiences a tragedy, and Maura uses the opportunity to encourage Dougal to lead; Murtagh defends Grace from harm, with terrible ramifications for their relationship; Henry watches as a new and dangerous romance unfolds.

While this is bad enough, Jeffrey (Jeremy Sheffield), the man who left her as they moved closer to marriage, happens to be the groom's best man. Determined to show everyone -- most of all Jeffrey -- that her romantic life is as full and thrilling as ever, Kat hires a charming male escort (Dermot Mulroney) as her date.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin
programme.desc: Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.

She decides to pack it in on the front lines and -- instead -- teach others the ropes of the high-pressure job. But when a call from a kidnapped teen (Abigail Breslin) comes in, Jordan takes charge as never before and turns the girl into a partner in helping to save her life.

programme.title: The Preacher's Wife
programme.desc: A cleric begins to doubt himself and is visited by an angel. The heavenly emissary is supposed to help the good reverend over his midlife crisis, but he is distracted by the cleric's lovely young wife. A remake with gospel music of the "The Bishop's Wife".

programme.title: Michael
programme.desc: The journey of pop star Michael Jackson, from his early days to the visionary artist whose creative ambition fuels a pursuit to become the biggest entertainer in the world.

programme.title: The 40 Year-Old Virgin
programme.desc: Three dysfunctional co-workers embark on a mission to help their newfound friend lose his sexual innocence.

On the menu this November are turkey, sweet potatoes, and pumpkin pie -- but also tamales, spring rolls, kugel, mac & cheese, love, betrayal, sibling rivalry, prejudice, politics, uninvited guests, unexpected accidents, outrageous conversations -- and all the other succulent and spicy surprises that arise when modern families come together for an annual meal.

programme.title: Ex-Husbands
programme.desc: Manhattan dentist Peter Pearce is facing a midlife crisis after his wife of 35 years leaves him. On the spur of the moment, he books a trip to Tulum, Mexico, only to crash his son's bachelor party.

programme.title: Another Merry Deranged Holy Unhinged Christmas Affair
programme.desc: Two couples come together for the holidays, encountering humor, surprises and plenty of holiday cheer.

programme.title: Ant-Man
programme.desc: Forced out of his own company by former protégé Darren Cross, Dr. Hank Pym recruits the talents of Scott Lang, a master thief just released from prison. Lang becomes Ant-Man, trained by Pym and armed with a suit that allows him to shrink in size, possess superhuman strength and control an army of ants. The miniature hero must use his new skills to prevent Cross, also known as Yellowjacket, from perfecting the same technology and using it as a weapon for evil.

programme.title: Altitude
programme.desc: A plane full of teens with a rookie pilot battles against a supernatural force.

She soon finds herself in big trouble when a corrupt cop hands her over to the same goons who shot up the place. Their gang leader, Lino, decides to use Gloria for his dirty work to avoid detection from the Drug Enforcement Administration. Determined to get away, Gloria must now play a dangerous game to outwit not only the cartel, but the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.

programme.title: Krystal

programme.desc: Eight couples experience the joys and difficulties of relationships.

Living alongside his mother, younger brother, and conservative aunt, Ulysses is also struggling with questions about his gender identity. programme.desc: A seedy private eye (Dennis Miller) helps a televangelist's employee (Erika Eleniak), whose brother vanished at a brothel of female vampires.

programme.title: Pixels

programme.desc: A seedy private eye (Dennis Miller) helps a televangelist's employee (Erika Eleniak), whose brother vanished at a brothel of female vampires.

programme.title: Krystal

As a cause of anxiety for Danny, Bart Beeber, the nerdiest guy in school, has already found a date -- and booked a hotel room. At the same time, Danny's divorced parents are both looking for relationships again.

programme.title: Norm of the North: Family Vacation
programme.desc: Norm searches for his missing crown while fixing his family relationships.

programme.title: Pups United

programme.title: Last Chance Harvey
programme.desc: In London for his daughter's wedding, a struggling jingle-writer, Harvey Shine (Dustin Hoffman), misses his plane to New York, and thus loses his job. While drowning his sorrows in the airport pub, Harvey meets Kate (Emma Thompson), a British government worker stuck in an endless cycle of work, phone calls from her mother, and blind dates. A connection forms between the unhappy pair, who soon find themselves falling in love.

programme.title: Jungle Master

programme.title: Puppy Swap: Love Unleashed

programme.title: Girl in Progress

Inspired by the coming-of-age stories her English teacher introduces in class, Ansiedad decides to skip adolescence and jump-start her life without her mother. But, when the misguided plan unravels, Ansiedad and Grace must both learn that growing up means acting your age.

programme.title: Wagon Train - The Christopher Hale Story
programme.desc: Flint returns to the wagon train camp to announce that their company has appointed Jud Benedict as their new wagonmaster, and it isn't good news.

programme.title: Wagon Train - The Tiburcio Mendez Story

programme.desc: A new school teacher -- also an ex-convict -- becomes suspected of murdering a Wells Fargo agent.

programme.title: Cheyenne - Town of Fear
programme.desc: Cheyenne faces an angry town and a dangerous gunman to save the life of an old friend.

programme.title: Maverick - The Judas Mask
programme.desc: A dance hall girl steals money from Bart.

programme.title: Maverick - The Jail at Junction Flats

programme.title: Don't Wait, Django... Shoot!

Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Damsel
programme.desc: Samuel Alabaster, an affluent pioneer, ventures across the American frontier to marry the love of his life, Penelope. As his group traverses the West, the once-simple journey grows treacherous, blurring the lines between hero, villain and damsel.

programme.title: The Burrowers
programme.desc: A rescue party comes face to face with underground creatures attacking a town.

programme.title: Gone Are the Days
programme.desc: With his days winding down, an aging gunman sets out on a quest to perform one last good deed, hoping to save his soul.

When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Anomaly

programme.title: Empire Waist

But her image-conscious mother's fears and Lenore's own deep self-loathing prevent her from wearing her own designs. Will Lenore ever feel the self-love she inspires in others?

programme.title: Sweet Potato Pie
programme.desc: Three virginal buddies (Marc 7, Saafir, Mr. Short Khop) go on a quest for their first sexual encounter.

programme.title: A Girl Like Grace

As she yearns for acceptance in the world, Grace finds herself bullied at school by Mary (Raven-Symoné). She seeks guidance from her best friend Andrea (Paige Hurd) and Share, Andrea's older sister.

programme.title: Pain & Gain

programme.title: We Bare Bears - Our Stuff
programme.desc: After the bears play a little pickup basketball, they go back to grab their stuff by the side of the court, only to find it's been stolen; the Bears race across town trying to track down their stuff and end up cracking a giant case in the process.

programme.title: Megan Leavey
programme.desc: The true life story of Megan Leavey, a young Marine corporal whose unique discipline and bond with a military combat dog saved many lives during her deployment in Iraq. Assigned to clean up the K-9 unit after a disciplinary hearing, Leavey starts to identify with Rex, a particularly aggressive dog that she trains. Over the course of their service, Megan and Rex complete more than 100 missions until an improvised explosive device injures both, putting their fates in jeopardy.

programme.title: Shot Caller
programme.desc: Recently released from prison, a gang member finds himself forced by his leaders to orchestrate a major crime with a rival gang.

programme.title: Shut In
programme.desc: Mary Portman is a widowed child psychologist who lives in isolation in rural Maine. The horrific car accident that killed her husband also left her 18-year-old stepson Stephen in a bedridden, catatonic state, leaving him completely dependent on her. When one of Portman's young patients vanishes without a trace, she becomes convinced that the boy's ghost is now in the house as a dangerous ice storm starts to wreak havoc outside.

programme.title: Catfish
programme.desc: When Nev Shulman, a New York photographer, receives a Facebook request from a child named Abby, he cannot guess the unusual odyssey on which he will soon embark. Abby sends Nev an unusually skilled painting based on one of his photos. Intrigued, he begins online relationships with the rest of Abby's family, including her older sister, Megan. Though troubling inconsistencies soon emerge, Nev continues his online flirtation with Megan, resulting in a road trip to meet her in person.

programme.title: The Greatest Showman
programme.desc: Growing up in the early 1800s, P.T. Barnum displays a natural talent for publicity and promotion, selling lottery tickets by age 12. After trying his hands at various jobs, P.T. turns to show business to indulge his limitless imagination, rising from nothing to create the Barnum & Bailey circus. Featuring catchy musical numbers, exotic performers and daring acrobatic feats, Barnum's mesmerizing spectacle soon takes the world by storm to become the greatest show on Earth.

programme.title: Ocean's Eleven
programme.desc: Dapper Danny Ocean is a man of action. Less than 24 hours into his parole from a New Jersey penitentiary, the wry, charismatic thief is already rolling out his next plan. Following three rules: Don't hurt anybody, don't steal from anyone who doesn't deserve it, and play the game like you've got nothing to lose. Danny orchestrates the most sophisticated, elaborate casino heist in history.

programme.title: Ocean's Twelve
programme.desc: After successfully robbing five casinos in one night, Danny Ocean and his crew of thieves have big problems. Despite pulling off one of the biggest heists in Las Vegas history, the members of the gang have already spent much of the money they stole. Casino owner Terry Benedict demands that Ocean return the money, plus millions more in interest. Unable to come up the cash, the crew is forced to come together to pull off another series of heists, this time in Europe.

programme.title: Ocean's Thirteen
programme.desc: Danny Ocean and his gang hatch an ambitious plot for revenge after ruthless casino owner Willy Bank double-crosses Reuben Tishkoff, Danny's friend and mentor. First, Ocean's gang plan to hit Bank in the paycheck by reversing the precept that the house always wins. Next, they will deal a crushing blow to Bank's ego by ruining his reputation as the only hotelier to earn the Royal Review's Five Diamond Award for each of his properties.

programme.title: Our Kind of Traitor
programme.desc: A money launderer (Stellan Skarsgard) for Russian gangsters asks a couple vacationing in Marrakech, Morocco, to deliver incriminating evidence to an MI6 agent (Damian Lewis).

programme.title: Wonka
programme.desc: Armed with nothing but a hatful of dreams, young chocolatier Willy Wonka manages to change the world, one delectable bite at a time.

programme.title: Hoot
programme.desc: Roy Eberhardt (Logan Lerman) has moved so often he has lost track of how many times he has changed schools. After moving from Montana to Florida's Gulf Coast, he befriends Beatrice (Brie Larson) and her brother. The siblings show Roy their hideaway, where they secretly take care of a flock of wild owls. When they learn that a restaurant will be built where the owls live, the three decide to enlist the help of a local policeman (Luke Wilson) to save the birds.

programme.title: The Sessions
programme.desc: Though a childhood bout with polio left him dependent on an iron lung, Mark O'Brien (John Hawkes) maintains a career as a journalist and poet. A writing assignment dealing with sex and the disabled piques Mark's curiosity, and he decides to investigate the possibility of experiencing sex himself. When his overtures toward a caregiver (Annika Marks) scare her away, he books an appointment with sex surrogate Cheryl Cohen Green (Helen Hunt) to lose his virginity.

programme.title: Pacific Rim Uprising
programme.desc: Jake Pentecost is a once-promising Jaeger pilot whose legendary father gave his life to secure humanity's victory against the monstrous Kaiju. Jake has since abandoned his training only to become caught up in a criminal underworld. But when an even more unstoppable threat is unleashed to tear through cities and bring the world to its knees, Jake is given one last chance by his estranged sister, Mako Mori, to live up to his father's legacy.

programme.title: The Predator
programme.desc: From the outer reaches of space to the small-town streets of suburbia, the hunt comes home. The universe's most lethal hunters are stronger, smarter and deadlier than ever before, having genetically upgraded themselves with DNA from other species. When a boy accidentally triggers their return to Earth, only a ragtag crew of ex-soldiers and an evolutionary biologist can prevent the end of the human race.

programme.title: Maximum Risk
programme.desc: French police officer Alain Moreau makes an astonishing discovery: Mikhail, a man who died recently in a breakneck car chase, is the twin brother he never knew. Alain then uncovers a web of family secrets that lead him to New York City, where his brother was involved with the Russian Mafia. Teaming up with Mikhail's lover, Alex Minetti, Alain must now assume his twin's identity and go undercover to avenge Mikhail's death.

programme.title: Desperate Measures
programme.desc: Widowed cop Frank Conner (Andy Garcia) is determined to secure a bone marrow transplant for his son, Matt (Joseph Cross), who will die of leukemia if a suitable donor isn't found. Conner discovers that incarcerated serial murderer Peter McCabe (Michael Keaton) is a match for Matt, and the psychopath eventually agrees to donate marrow, but he escapes from the operating room just before the procedure. Conner quickly follows, but the scheming McCabe won't be easily apprehended.

programme.title: Mortal Thoughts
programme.desc: A loathsome man ends up dead, but it's not clear who's to blame. If ever a person got what he deserved, it's James Urbanski (Bruce Willis), an abusive drunk who steals from his wife, Joyce (Glenne Headly), and promises her close friend Cynthia Kellogg (Demi Moore) that she'll be the next target of his rage. At a group outing, James bleeds to death after someone cuts his throat. But because he's such a terrible human being, police aren't sure which of his acquaintances decided to kill him.

programme.title: Obsessed
programme.desc: Things couldn't be better for Derek Charles (Idris Elba). He's just received a big promotion at work, and has a wonderful marriage with his beautiful wife, Sharon (Beyoncé Knowles). However, into this idyllic world steps Lisa (Ali Larter), a temporary worker at Derek's office. Lisa begins to stalk Derek, jeopardizing all he holds dear.

programme.title: It Could Happen to You
programme.desc: Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: Stealing Harvard
programme.desc: John (Jason Lee) is a hard-working guy who only wants to marry his longtime girlfriend Elaine (Leslie Mann). Elaine and John have vowed to marry once they save $30,000 for their dream house. Things are fine until John's sister calls to remind him of his promise to pay his niece's tuition, which costs $29,829 and is due in two weeks! John turns to his friend Duff (Tom Green) to help him make $30,000 quickly. Duff convinces John to make a short-term commitment to petty crime.

programme.title: Whatever It Takes
programme.desc: A nerdy teen, Ryan Woodman (Shane West) is smitten with the popular and gorgeous Ashley Grant (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe), who apparently has no interest in him. Meanwhile, dim star athlete Chris Campbell (James Franco) has his eye on Ryan's brainy and beautiful friend, Maggie Carter (Marla Sokoloff). The two agree to help each other in their romantic quests, but, as they come closer to their goals, both Ryan and Chris suspect that they might be pursuing the wrong girls.

programme.title: The Waterdance
programme.desc: Injured in a climbing accident, writer Joel Garcia (Eric Stoltz) wakes up in a hospital having lost the use of his legs. Soon after, he's placed in a recovery ward where he begins the arduous process of rehabilitation and meets others with injuries like his own. Raymond (Wesley Snipes) is a ladies' man whose girl has nevertheless split, and Bloss (William Forsythe) is a rather prejudiced biker. Together, this unlikely trio helps one another to overcome the greatest challenge of their lives.

programme.title: Finding Graceland
programme.desc: En route to Memphis, Tenn., on a solemn solo road trip, widower Byron Gruman picks up a disarming hitchhiker who claims to be the late, great Elvis Presley. As Gruman opens up about the loss of his wife, Beatrice, in a tragic car accident, his bizarre passenger becomes a surprisingly powerful source of wisdom and comfort. The duo even picks up a Marilyn Monroe impersonator, Ashley, during the surreal pilgrimage to Graceland.

programme.title: Eve - OVER
programme.desc: Just when Shelly thinks she and J.T. are making progress, she learns that his idea of compromise involves her changing who she is.

programme.desc: Shelly reads a self-help book that encourages her to spend time with herself in order to get over her breakup.

programme.title: Eve - All My Exes Havin' Sexes
programme.desc: Rita and Janie warn Shelly about sleeping with J.T., but Shelly ignores them until she realizes that she is behaving as if she and J.T. were still together.

programme.title: Eve - The Hate-Trix Reloaded
programme.desc: Shelly takes the advice of a self-help book and sends an e-mail to J.T. asking for her stuff, sparking petty attempts at payback that spiral out of control.

programme.title: Eve - Footloose
programme.desc: When Shelly turns to J.T. for help with a knee injury, she ends up getting a date with a doctor and making J.T. jealous.

programme.title: Eve - Splice of Life
programme.desc: Shelly feels left out when Rita, after being evicted, comes to stay with Janie and the two rediscover their Cajun roots together.

programme.title: The Parkers - Love Is a Royal Pain
programme.desc: Nikki attends her high-school reunion with professor Oglevee, while Kim secretly dates her mother's old flame.

programme.title: The Parkers - Funny, Funny Valentine
programme.desc: When Nikki finds out that professor Oglevee is going to propose to Veronica, she spends the evening with her ex-husband.

programme.desc: Chef JJ cooks up some food that will have you coming back for more. It's double delicious and double the flavor! First it's Short Rib Grilled Cheese, then it's Spicy Island Wings, and both can be served with his Salt & Pepper Chips.

programme.desc: A British rocket scientist (Brian Donlevy) hunts an astronaut monstrously enveloped by an alien fungus.

programme.title: Reptilicus
programme.desc: Copenhagen is terrorized by a prehistoric beast that has regenerated itself from a recently discovered tail segment.

programme.title: Voodoo Island
programme.desc: A writer famous for exposing hoaxes investigates a tropical island supposedly rife with voodoo horrors.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: Incident in an Alley
programme.desc: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

programme.title: The Woman in the Window
programme.desc: With his family packed off to Maine, Professor Richard Wanley is anticipating some quiet time alone. Then he meets Alice, the model for a portrait he admires, and can't resist her offer of a drink. No sooner do they get to her place, however, than her jealous boyfriend arrives in a rage. Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

programme.title: The Man in the Net
programme.desc: Big city advertising artist John Hamilton (Alan Ladd) abandons his career and relocates to a sleepy Connecticut community to paint for himself instead of for a paycheck. But his erratic spouse, Linda (Carolyn Jones), quickly grows bored with her quiet new life and begins to lash out at him. After turning to the bottle, Linda begins to openly insult her husband and even accuses him of beating her. So later, when she goes missing, the locals suspect John of murder and an angry mob comes after him.

programme.title: Lady of Vengeance
programme.desc: When publisher William Marshall (Dennis O'Keefe) learns his young ward Melissa Collins (Eileen Elton) has committed suicide, he sets in motion a plan to murder the man who drove her to kill herself. Mistakenly believing that singer Larry Shaw (Vernon Greeves) is his intended target, Marshall unwittingly seeks help from the man who actually broke Melissa's heart, criminal Emile Karnak (Anton Diffring). When Marshall learns the truth, however, he turns his efforts toward Karnak instead.

programme.title: Four Boys and a Gun
programme.desc: Young toughs will all die in the electric chair unless they tell who killed a policeman during a holdup.

programme.title: The Big Knife
programme.desc: Movie star Charles Castle draws the ire of Hollywood producer Stanley Hoff when he refuses to sign a new seven-year contract. Castle is sick of the low quality of the studio's films and wants to start a new life. While his estranged wife supports him in the decision, Castle's talent agent urges him to reconsider. When Castle continues to be uncooperative, Hoff resorts to blackmail in order to get his way.

programme.title: Behind the Mask
programme.desc: The Shadow (Kane Richmond) tracks a killer to a clip joint and exposes a city editor's racket.

programme.title: The Ape
programme.desc: Dr. Bernard Adrian (Boris Karloff) is researching a way to help a wheelchair-bound patient, Frances (Maris Wrixon), use her legs again. The only way he can achieve this is by procuring spinal fluid from a human. When an ape escapes from a circus, Dr. Adrian kills it in a confrontation and successfully uses its spinal fluid on Frances -- but he needs more. Using the ape's body as a suit, he kills townspeople in a crazed attempt to complete his plan.

programme.title: The Neanderthal Man
programme.desc: A scientist (Robert Shayne) turns his maid into an ape-woman, his cat into a tiger and himself into an ape-man.

programme.title: The Screaming Skull
programme.desc: A man (John Hudson) tries to drive his second wife (Peggy Webber) mad at his dead first wife's Southern mansion.

programme.title: Portrait in Terror
programme.desc: An English killer (Patrick Magee) and a weird artist (William Campbell) plot to steal a painting in Venice, Calif.

programme.title: Incident in an Alley
programme.desc: A policeman (Chris Warfield) hears a woman scream, fires his gun and stands trial for killing a boy.

Richard kills him in self-defense, and they decide to hide the body. Things go smoothly until Richard's D.A. friend invites him to tag along on the investigation of his own crime.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elijah Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Act of Vengeance
programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Mercenary Fighters
programme.desc: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: For Us, the Living
programme.desc: During the civil rights movement of the '50s and '60s in Mississippi, Medgar Evers (Howard E. Rollins Jr.) rose from being an insurance agent to become one of the most integral activists of the era. From boycotting white merchants in the mid '50s to being a key figure in desegregating the University of Mississippi in 1962, Evers met success, and with it many enemies. When racists swarm his house, his life and the lives of his wife (Irene Cara) and children are threatened.
